exclusions_of_note.name: Products-Completed Operations Hazard EXCLUDED (entire hazard)
exclusions_of_note.impact: CRITICAL for an aerospace machine shop. Dec page (Pg 6) shows Products-Completed Operations Aggregate Limit = EXCLUDED and Products/Completed Operations advance premium = $0.00. Combined with CG 21 04, this means BI/PD arising out of the insured's products or completed work AFTER the work is finished or product leaves their possession is wholly uninsured. For Precision Aero (precision aerospace machining), a defective machined part causing an in-flight or ground incident produces a catastrophic uninsured exposure. A Products Liability policy or restoring Products-Completed Ops on the CGL is required.

exclusions_of_note.name: Limitation of Coverage to Designated Premises or Project
exclusions_of_note.impact: CGL only responds to operations at 5310 S 32nd St, Phoenix. Any off-site work, customer-site visits, trade shows, or operations at a second location are uninsured for liability. Manufacturers that occasionally install, service, or visit customer sites face a real coverage gap.

exclusions_of_note.name: Silica or Silica-Related Dust Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Bars BI/PD/Personal & Advertising Injury arising out of silica or silica-related dust. Material to a machine shop performing grinding, cutting, or finishing operations that could generate respirable silica. A Contractors/Industrial Pollution Liability or industrial hygiene-specific policy would be needed.

exclusions_of_note.name: Contractual Liability Limitation
exclusions_of_note.impact: Materially narrows the 'insured contract' definition in the base CGL form. Hold-harmless and indemnity obligations Precision Aero accepts in customer purchase orders or supplier MSAs may not be picked up by CGL contractual liability coverage. Contracts with significant indemnity obligations should be reviewed against this form.

exclusions_of_note.name: Access or Disclosure of Confidential or Personal Information / Data-Related Liability
exclusions_of_note.impact: No CGL coverage for data breach, biometric privacy claims, or loss of/damage to electronic data. A standalone Cyber Liability policy is required.

exclusions_of_note.name: Cyber Incident Exclusion (Inland Marine)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes IM Motor Transit Cargo loss caused by hacking, malware, or DOS attacks. Resulting fire/explosion exception only. A Cyber Liability policy with property/extra expense extensions would respond.

exclusions_of_note.name: Designated Operations Covered by Consolidated (Wrap-Up) Insurance Program
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes coverage for operations covered (or required to be covered) by an OCIP/CCIP. Generally appropriate, but flags any wrap-required projects as needing the wrap as primary.

exclusions_of_note.name: Engineers, Architects or Surveyors Professional Liability Exclusion + Designated Professional Services Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Strips professional services exposure from CGL. If Precision Aero performs design/engineering, draws specifications, or provides any professional advice on parts, this is uninsured. Standalone Manufacturer's E&O / Professional Liability policy needed if there is any design responsibility.

exclusions_of_note.name: Asbestos Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Standard. Generally not material to a current machining operation but flagged for completeness.

exclusions_of_note.name: Employment-Related Practices Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes employment claims (harassment, discrimination, wrongful termination). EPLI policy required.

exclusions_of_note.name: Specified New Residential Construction Work Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Largely moot for a machine shop, but compounds the Products-Completed Operations exclusion if any incidental residential work were ever performed.

exclusions_of_note.name: Terrorism (TRIA) coverage REJECTED
exclusions_of_note.impact: No coverage anywhere on the program for losses arising out of certified acts of terrorism. For a Phoenix industrial location this may be an acceptable risk; flag for client confirmation given aerospace customer base.

exclusions_of_note.name: Actual Cash Value Endorsement
exclusions_of_note.impact: Modifies all Property and Inland Marine forms to define loss settlement as ACV (replacement cost less depreciation). Conflicts with Property Dec page markings showing BPP as Replacement Cost & Agreed Value and Building Improvement/Betterment + Legal Liability as Replacement Cost. Carrier should confirm in writing which valuation actually applies — if ACV controls, $11.8M BPP recovery could be materially reduced by depreciation on machinery, tooling, and equipment.

exclusions_of_note.name: Protective Safeguards Warranty (P-1 Automatic Sprinkler)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Coverage is automatically suspended if Precision Aero fails to immediately notify Pekin of any sprinkler suspension/impairment, or fails to maintain the sprinkler system. A non-functioning sprinkler at the time of loss = no coverage. Operational discipline required.

exclusions_of_note.name: Employee Benefits E&O - Retroactive Date 03/01/2016
exclusions_of_note.impact: Claims-made coverage with prior acts limited to 03/01/2016. Negligent benefits administration acts/errors/omissions before 03/01/2016 are uninsured even if the claim is made today. Verify whether any prior acts coverage existed pre-2016 (since the company has presumably administered benefits longer than 8 years).
